notes: Official Australian Zambrero nutritional information PDF; PDF states nutrition data is correct as of 8 April 2026, V7.1 080426. The public allergens page currently says nutrition data is correct as of March 2026, so the PDF date is treated as the more precise source.
All meal rows below are official per-serve values from tables marked 'without sauce'. Sauce choice is not included and can add calories.
Zambrero says nutrition is based on analytical and calculated data using standard serving sizes; actual finished product sizes, assembly, formulations, seasonality, and suppliers may vary.

Vegetarian suitability is based on Zambrero's live Australian menu labels. The menu lists both Pulled Mushroom and Vegetarian choices as GF/VG/V, but says the Vegetarian choice, excluding pulled mushroom, includes guacamole, beans, and rice.
Menu descriptions include sauce in normal builds, while the nutrition PDF rows are without sauce. This is the main trap if importing these into a meal picker.
Big formats and rows with obvious PDF text extraction glitches were excluded to keep the proposal small and high-confidence.
